segments.name: North America
segments.description: Sells better-for-you yogurt, tea, baby and kids foods, pantry and personal care products to retailers and distributors in the U.S. and Canada.
segments.evidence: The Company's organizational structure consists of two geographic based reportable segments: North America and International, which are also the operating segments.

revenueModel.text: Retailers, distributors, e-commerce sellers and food service providers pay the company for its branded and private label food and personal care products.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customer base consists principally of supermarkets and natural food stores, mass-market, club stores, specialty and natural food distributors, e-commerce retailers, and away from home channels, including drug and convenience stores and food service.
